• Understanding human development (including academic) is
 based (fundamentally) on both norms and criteria (e.g., failure
 to thrive)

 • Under what circumstances do we define distinct norms and
 criteria for different groups of individuals (e.g., male/female
 height and weight charts)

 • In all state assessment programs, students identified as special
 education have (on average) lower achievement and lower
 growth than non-special education students.
